purpose: Give numerical finite-random vs between-mock engineering evidence for the existing 24D E4 pilot without claiming physical window calibration or inferential covariance.

identifiers.joint_vector_order: NGC ell1 six s bins; NGC ell3 six s bins; SGC ell1 six s bins; SGC ell3 six s bins
identifiers.galaxy_selection: same unchanged original 600D per tracer/cap/ID across E4 levels

tests_before_numbers: Fail closed on original full E4 Git blob and independent 24D erratum Git blob drifts, full 18 case completeness and no-observed seals.
Reconstruct 3 level 24D vectors per each of nine IDs from original E4 original_physical_domain_multipoles values_by_fixed_s_bin (ell=1 and ell=3, both caps).
Require exact 144/144 RR support at each E4 case and level, untouched 600D fixed selection and no NaN.

Validate all 9 by 3 signed 24D vector differences against independently archived E4 erratum as read-only cross-check (equality numerical tolerance only for bookkeeping), not by claiming independent actual FITS replay.
Reject mock subset, subset-selected bins, mixed caps, tracer orientation swap, failed source identity and any observed input.
Use NO original full mock0001 48000R as an independent matched comparison because its full mock galaxy DD is different from original E4 600D.

descriptive_outputs_before_computation.per_comparison_per_24_component: Arithmetic mean paired delta, root-mean-square paired delta across nine frozen IDs; standard deviation of high-random-level original E4 24D mock values using N-1 divisor, and ratio of two purely descriptive scales if finite/nonzero.
descriptive_outputs_before_computation.per_comparison_per_group: NGC ell1, NGC ell3, SGC ell1, SGC ell3, NGC twelve, SGC twelve, joint 24: paired RMS over all IDs and components; high-level between-ID centered RMS with N-1 denominator per component; ratio of RMS scales.
descriptive_outputs_before_computation.per_mock: For all nine fixed IDs, each full 24D Euclidean norm and max absolute component for all three level comparisons and high-level source sha.
descriptive_outputs_before_computation.source_value_handling: Do not store or publish full 444 KB JSON again; small aggregate JSON, all 24 per-component statistics, all nine per-ID group metrics only.
descriptive_outputs_before_computation.covariance: DO NOT invert or estimate inferential 24D covariance from nine mock IDs; rank bound <=8; even per-component sd is descriptive and contains finite random error.
descriptive_outputs_before_computation.interpretation: Finite-random shift is not independent noise because nested levels share random rows; between-mock scatter is not an independent cosmic variance estimate; no science cut, normalization to null sigma, p value or detection claims.

stop_conditions: any source SHA/blob mismatch or failed original support/source status
any case or level missing or RR support !=144
missing independent erratum signed shift or mismatch
observed data or non-E4 file access
attempt to claim 0001 fullmock E7 as same-DD E4 random-only comparison
attempt to rank/postselect bins or inference from nine mocks
